product_overview: DoneTogether is a collaborative planning app for friends and small groups to create shared plans, track checklist progress, and coordinate around tasks together. Users can also manage friendships, share invite links, switch languages, and set location-based reminders on plan items.
core_goals: Sign in and access the collaborative planning experience
Create shared plans with checklist items and track progress
Invite others to join plans through codes or links
Manage friends through search, requests, and friend list controls
Attach locations and reminder triggers to checklist items
Switch the app language and theme without disrupting core workflows

features.name: Language switching
features.description: Let users change the app language between English, Swedish, and Turkish while keeping the interface usable in the login modal and main app.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open language switcher -> Select Svenska -> See visible UI text update -> Continue using the app
Navigate to / -> Open language switcher -> Select Turkish -> See visible UI text update -> Continue using the app

features.name: User authentication
features.description: Allow users to sign in with email and password from the login modal, and sign out after authenticating.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open sign-in entry -> Choose email login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> See the signed-in state
Navigate to / -> Open sign-in entry -> Choose email login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the form -> See an authentication error message
Navigate to / -> Open sign-in entry -> Choose Google sign-in -> Complete the authentication flow -> See the signed-in state
Navigate to / -> While signed in, open the account menu -> Sign out -> See the unauthenticated state

features.name: Create and manage plans
features.description: Enable signed-in users to create collaborative plans, manage checklist items, track completion, add photos and reactions, and reopen completed plans.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Create new plan -> Enter a plan name -> Add optional items -> Save the plan -> See the new plan in the active plans list
Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open a plan detail -> Add a checklist item -> Edit an item -> Delete an item -> Mark an item complete -> See progress update
Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open a plan detail -> Complete an item -> Attach a photo to the completed item -> Add an emoji reaction -> See the item updated with media and reaction
Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open a completed plan -> Reopen the plan -> See it return to active planning state

features.name: Join plan via invite
features.description: Let signed-in users join an existing plan by entering an invite code or using a shared invite link.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open join plan flow -> Enter an invite code -> Confirm joining -> See the plan added successfully
Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open a shared invite link -> Confirm joining the plan -> See the plan open in the app

features.name: Friends
features.description: Allow signed-in users to search for people by email, send friend requests, respond to incoming requests, and manage their friend list.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open friends area -> Search by email -> Send a friend request -> See the request recorded
Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open friends area -> Review an incoming request -> Accept the request -> See the person added to the friend list
Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open friends area -> Review an incoming request -> Decline the request -> See the request removed
Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open friends area -> View the friend list -> Remove a friend -> See the friend removed

features.name: Share plan
features.description: Allow signed-in users to share a plan by copying an invite link or invite code from the share modal.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open a plan -> Open share flow -> Copy the invite link -> Close the share modal
Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open a plan -> Open share flow -> Copy the invite code -> Close the share modal

features.name: Location and geofence on items
features.description: Let signed-in users attach a location, radius, and trigger type to checklist items using saved places or address search.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Grant location permission -> Open location picker for an item -> Search for an address -> Select the location -> Set a radius -> Choose an enter trigger -> Save the location
Navigate to / -> Sign in -> Open location picker for an item -> Choose a saved location -> Set a radius -> Choose an exit trigger -> Save the location

features.name: Theme toggle
features.description: Switch the app between light and dark appearance without disrupting navigation or core actions.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the theme toggle -> See the app switch to dark mode
Navigate to / -> Click the theme toggle again -> See the app switch back to light mode

features.name: App update prompt
features.description: Show an update modal to users when a newer Android app version is available and allow them to dismiss it or start the update.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See an update prompt when a newer version is available -> Choose to dismiss it later -> Continue using the app
Navigate to / -> See an update prompt when a newer version is available -> Start the update download -> Continue with the update flow

known_limitations.issue: App is a single-route SPA; plan/friends/auth screens are modals and in-page state, not separate URL routes
known_limitations.impact: Automated tests must drive UI via buttons and modals rather than navigating /login or /plans URLs

known_limitations.issue: Google OAuth popup is difficult for headless automation
known_limitations.impact: Prefer email/password test credentials for automated login

known_limitations.issue: Email/Password provider must be enabled in Firebase Console for email login to work
known_limitations.impact: Email login fails if provider is disabled or test user does not exist

known_limitations.issue: Physical geofence enter/exit depends on device GPS
known_limitations.impact: Full geofence firing may not be verifiable in cloud browser tests
